title: ADR-003: LangGraph adapter boundary
summary: docs/adr/ADR-003-langgraph-adapter-boundary.md · 原文保留历史日期；先学主课程，需要核查时再读。
html:
Status: Accepted in M0.

LangGraph is an Agent runtime implementation detail. Business modules depend on AgentHub contracts, not LangGraph graph/node types. Checkpoint setup is explicit and framework-owned; API startup does not mutate checkpoint schema.
